provenance: Per-language sequence tables and per-code-page character-order maps of the statistical single-byte detector used by the reference (Mozilla universal charset detector lineage, via the uchardet language models). Order values: 255 illegal, 254 control, 253 symbol, 252 line break, 251 digit, 0..N frequency rank (0 most frequent). 'matrix' is a string of freqCharCount^2 digits (0..3), row = previous letter rank, column = current rank. Probers are listed in evaluation order (index = i).
